scenario: TTL-lifecycle fact still alive *before* its deadline. Mirror of TEMP-001 with an advance that stops short — pins that the deadline is real, not just a side effect of pump. A `ttl` fact expires via its TTL (LFAC.1.3.3), and only once its deadline is at or before the clock (RARC.5.2.4). Named for the LFAC.1.2 heading (`logical` facts), which it does not test.
